import pyautogui, time

# Click at the start of line 2 to set the selection anchor
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.click(300, 200)

# Extend selection down to line 10
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
pyautogui.click(300, 328)
pyautogui.keyUp('shift')

# Indent the selected lines
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('tab')
